description: Execute a Circle Gateway USDC transfer through Felix Arc settlement with the client-held owner key: approve and deposit on the source chain, sign the EIP-712 burn intent, mint on the destination chain, and reconcile until the funds are usable. Every transaction is signed locally and broadcast through the journey-scoped settlement relay, so no client RPC is needed. Returns immediately with an fxop_ operation_id; poll get_money_operation or wait_for_operation, and use get_arc_transfer for the server-side journey state. Finality can take 15-20 minutes when the source chain is not Arc.

amount_usd.description: USDC that must arrive on the destination, in whole USDC (six decimals).

destination_domain.description: Circle Gateway domain id of the destination chain; must differ from source_domain.

idempotency_key.description: Journey replay key. Reuse it for submit_arc_transfer so the same prepared journey is executed, and after any timeout.

maximum_fee_usd.description: Maximum Circle Gateway fee the owner accepts on top of amount_usd. Defaults to 0.05 USDC; the deposit is amount plus this ceiling and any unused ceiling stays in the owner's Gateway balance.

source_domain.description: Circle Gateway domain id of the source chain (Ethereum 0, Arbitrum 3, Base 6, Polygon 7; Arc's id is reported by get_deposit_address under arc.gateway_domain).

name: submit_arc_transfer
